description: Cosmic Code Crafters is a team of passionate problem-solvers, coders, and space enthusiasts dedicated to building creative solutions using NASA’s open data. We bridge the gap between complex space science and innovative code to engineer impact for Earth and beyond.
summary: ORBIÓN: Interactive Astronaut Mission Trainer for Kids. Built by Cosmic Code Crafters (Hammad Syed, Uzair Gulzair, and Krish Doshi). A gamified system designed for children aged 8-14 to make aerospace engineering accessible through hands-on simulations, NASA lunar data (terrain, temperatures, water ice, life support, and soil), and an offline, NASA-grounded Ollama AI that runs in under one second. Students balance life-support systems, explore lunar landers and rovers, and achieve faster learning mastery compared to traditional textbooks.
